data.title: Binghatti Flare
data.about:
Rising in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Binghatti Flare is a dynamic residential project by renowned developer Binghatti. Comprising two elegant towers, the development offers thoughtfully designed studio and 1-bedroom apartments, blending modern architecture with practical living. Residents can enjoy a host of lifestyle features including a swimming pool, fitness center, and children’s play area.

Binghatti Flare at JVT Dubai is designed to appeal to residents seeking both comfort and investment potential. From its strategic location to its curated lifestyle amenities, the project stands out for its quality and design. Binghatti’s reputation as a visionary developer, along with high rental yield potential in JVT, positions this development as a smart choice for investors and homeowners alike.

characteristics_module.title: Binghatti Flare by Binghatti Developers – Contemporary Living with Lifestyle Comforts and Premium Connectivity
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location - Situated in Jumeirah Village Triangle, offering seamless access to Dubai’s main highways and business hubs.
  • Reputed Developer - Developed by Binghatti, a brand known for its innovative designs and timely project delivery.
  • Premium Lifestyle Amenities - Includes a swimming pool, landscaped gardens, fitness centre, and spaces for families to unwind.
  • Attractive Investment - Promises a high return on investment with growing demand in the JVT area.
  • Smart Floor Plans - Offers well-laid studio and 1-bedroom apartments tailored to urban lifestyles.
  • Flexible Payment Plans - Choose from 60/40 with post-dated checks or 70/30 without post-dated checks.
  • Family-Friendly Environment - Features children’s play areas and picnic spaces in a safe and serene community.
  • Great Connectivity - Quick access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road ensures city-wide reach.

location_tile.title: Well-Connected Location with Seamless Citywide Access
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Flare at Jumeirah Village Triangle enjoys exceptional connectivity via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Al Khail Road (E44). This well-planned community ensures residents enjoy easy access to major destinations in Dubai while living in a peaceful suburban setting.

  • 10 Minutes – Jumeirah Golf Estates
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Sports City
  • 14 Minutes – The Springs Souk
  • 16 Minutes – Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 18 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 29 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
